SELECT DISTINCT SBSB.*,BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT, GRGR.GRGR_ID AS {Copy of GRGR_ID},BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT, 'I'  FROM FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I' INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP = 'DRCT' INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%' AND BLBL_PAID_STS = '1' AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT + (SELECT CASE WHEN (GRGR.GRGR_ID = 'NVSUPWP0'OR GRGR.GRGR_ID = 'NVSUP000') AND TO_CHAR (BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT, 'DD') >= 20 THEN 36 WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID = 'WISUPWP0' AND TO_CHAR (BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT, 'DD') >= 20 THEN 42 ELSE 31 END FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = GRGR_ID)+ 1 <= TO_DATE ('08/03/2016', 'MM/DD/YYYY') UNION SELECT DISTINCT SBSB.*,BLEI.BLEI_NET_ALLOC_SUSP, GRGR.GRGR_ID,SYSDATE,'D' FROM FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I' AND BLEI_NET_ALLOC_SUSP > 0 INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEEL_ELIG_ENT MEEL ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEEL.MEME_CK AND MEEL.MEEL_ELIG_TYPE = 'TM' AND MEEL.MEEL_MCTR_RSN IN ('090','ME2') INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBEL_ELIG_ENT SBEL ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBEL.SBSB_CK AND SBEL.SBEL_ELIG_TYPE = 'TM' AND SBEL_MCTR_RSN = '03' INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP = 'DRCT' INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%' WHERE TO_DATE ('08/3/2016', 'MM/DD/YYYY') >= CAST (TRUNC (MEEL.MEEL_INSQ_DT) AS DATE) + 4 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM FACETS.CMC_RCPT_RECEIPTS RCPT WHERE RCPT_INPUT_SBSB_ID = SBSB.SBSB_ID AND (RCPT_CREATE_DTM >=TO_DATE ('08/03/2016', 'MM/DD/YYYY') - 15) AND RCPT_RCPT_CD = 'F' AND RCPT_MCTR_RSN = 'DTH' )

SELECT DISTINCT SBSB.*,BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT, GRGR.GRGR_ID,BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT, 'I'  FROM FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I' INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP = 'DRCT' INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%' AND BLBL_PAID_STS = '1' AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT + (SELECT CASE WHEN (GRGR.GRGR_ID = 'NVSUPWP0'OR GRGR.GRGR_ID = 'NVSUP000') AND TO_CHAR (BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT, 'DD') >= 20 THEN 36 WHEN GRGR.GRGR_ID = 'WISUPWP0' AND TO_CHAR (BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT, 'DD') >= 20 THEN 42 ELSE 31 END FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = GRGR_ID)+ 1 <= TO_DATE ('08/03/2016', 'MM/DD/YYYY') UNION SELECT DISTINCT SBSB.*,BLEI.BLEI_NET_ALLOC_SUSP, GRGR.GRGR_ID,SYSDATE,'D' FROM FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I' AND BLEI_NET_ALLOC_SUSP > 0 INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEEL_ELIG_ENT MEEL ON MEME.MEME_CK = MEEL.MEME_CK AND MEEL.MEEL_ELIG_TYPE = 'TM' AND MEEL.MEEL_MCTR_RSN IN ('090','ME2') INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBEL_ELIG_ENT SBEL ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBEL.SBSB_CK AND SBEL.SBEL_ELIG_TYPE = 'TM' AND SBEL_MCTR_RSN = '03' INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD ON SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK AND SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP = 'DRCT' INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%' WHERE TO_DATE ('08/3/2016', 'MM/DD/YYYY') >= CAST (TRUNC (MEEL.MEEL_INSQ_DT) AS DATE) + 4 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM FACETS.CMC_RCPT_RECEIPTS RCPT WHERE RCPT_INPUT_SBSB_ID = SBSB.SBSB_ID AND (RCPT_CREATE_DTM >=TO_DATE ('08/03/2016', 'MM/DD/YYYY') - 15) AND RCPT_RCPT_CD = 'F' AND RCPT_MCTR_RSN = 'DTH' )

SELECT COUNT(1)  from Refund.Refund where BatchId=@BatchId  AND (PullInd  IS NULL OR PullInd='')

if not exists(SELECT TOP 1 1  from Refund.Refund where BatchId=@BatchId  AND (PullInd  IS NULL OR PullInd=''))
begin
EXEC [GENERIC].[Pr_UpdateEventLog] 2,3,1,'No records found to generate Auto Batch file.'
EXEC [GENERIC].[Pr_Update_Batch_Status] 
'[Refund].[Batch]',@BatchId,'Complete'
EXEC [GENERIC].[Pr_UpdateEventLog] 2,1,11,'Package for Refund completed.'
end

'/*SELECT DISTINCT SBSB.SBSB_ID,BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT, GRGR.GRGR_ID,BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT, 'I'
FROM FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI
    ON BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB
    ON     SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK
    AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD
    ON SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK 
    AND SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP = 'DRCT'
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME
    ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK
    AND SBSB.GRGR_CK = MEME.GRGR_CK
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE
    ON MEPE.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK 
    AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'
    AND SYSDATE BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT    
INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR
    ON     GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK
    AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%'
    AND BLBL_PAID_STS = '1'
    AND   BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT + (
                                   SELECT CASE WHEN     (GRGR.GRGR_ID = 'NVSUPWP0'OR GRGR.GRGR_ID = 'NVSUP000') 
                                    AND SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,3,1) IN ('S','P')
                                    THEN 36
                                    WHEN  GRGR.GRGR_ID = 'WISUPWP0'
                                    AND SUBSTR(MEPE.CSPI_ID,3,1) IN ('W')
                                    THEN 42
                                    ELSE 31 END
                                    FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = GRGR_ID)+ 1 <= TO_DATE('07/27/2026' ,'mm/dd/yyyy')

UNION */
SELECT DISTINCT SBSB.SBSB_ID,
                BLEI.BLEI_NET_ALLOC_SUSP,
                GRGR.GRGR_ID,
                SYSDATE,
                'D'
  FROM FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO  BLEI
       INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB
           ON     SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK
              AND BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'
              AND BLEI_NET_ALLOC_SUSP > 0
       INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK
       INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEEL_ELIG_ENT MEEL
           ON     MEME.MEME_CK = MEEL.MEME_CK
              AND MEEL.MEEL_ELIG_TYPE = 'TM'
    AND MEEL.MEEL_VOID_IND = 'N'      AND MEEL.MEEL_MCTR_RSN IN ('090', 'ME2', 'MS02')
       INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSP_SPLT_PREM SBSP
           ON SBSB.SBSB_CK = SBSP.SBSB_CK
       INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSD_SPLT_DTL SBSD
           ON     SBSD.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK
              AND SBSD.SBSP_EFF_DT = SBSP.SBSP_EFF_DT
              AND SYSDATE BETWEEN SBSP.SBSP_EFF_DT AND SBSP.SBSP_TERM_DT
              AND SBSD.SBSD_MCTR_STYP = 'DRCT'
       INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR
           ON GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK AND GRGR.GRGR_ID LIKE '%SUP%'
WHERE TO_DATE('07/27/2026' ,'mm/dd/yyyy') >= CAST (TRUNC (MEEL.MEEL_INSQ_DT) AS DATE) +10
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM FACETS.CMC_RCPT_RECEIPTS RCPT WHERE RCPT.RCPT_INPUT_SBSB_ID = SBSB.SBSB_ID
AND RCPT.RCPT_RCPT_CD = 'F' AND RCPT.RCPT_MCTR_RSN = 'DTH' AND RCPT.RCPT_STS IN ('01','91') AND RCPT.BLEI_CK = BLEI.BLEI_CK /*Added this as part of BFI- 10235 */)'
